purpose: Prospective regeneration of one selected local quest moment. This request has NOT been executed; execution.json is actual history.
moment: Landscape 3:2. Camera peers steeply down from lip INSIDE the same circular stone well, no diagram/cutaway/x-ray. K sits on broken projecting masonry ledge on RIGHT side, back against stone; right boot on ledge, LEFT leg lifted and tucked away, left ankle hurt. K both hands brace OWN ledge edges, eyes frightened down at D. D below left, torso pinned tightly between collapsed stone sides, unable to pass shoulders through; sunken grey-brown face and earth-filled mouth visible; one connected RIGHT arm reaches UP, five-finger hand stops below right boot separated by clear air gap. Stone ledge and shaft separate figures; D never grips K. Only these two figures visible; P/player outside above crop. Shaft lit by same overcast sky above camera. K charcoal seat/cuffs smeared damp clay. NO rescue rope on K yet: this is first sight before anchor. Show actual vertical distance without impossible perspectives.

causes.description: Current playable Russian text; local authored incident only.

One isolated work yard near Tikhaya Gat, late autumn overcast dry daylight; no rain. Square low weathered oak well curb, round irregular grey stone shaft below. Two vertical oak posts at opposite sides support one smooth horizontal bucket beam above the open mouth. A lean-to left of the well has a thick firmly planted front upright post for securing rope. Open simple gate on left background; crooked leafless birch on right; low timber fence; no church/castle/new buildings. Damp clay only around well and from excavation; straw-brown trampled grass elsewhere. Camera may move, layout may not. No modern pulley, steel crane or invented new winch.
